column1: # Columns: the weapon's editor ID (as in FalloutNV.esm, the DLC and Gun Runners' Arsenal), the
# multiplier of its calibre's muzzle velocity (1.0 = the calibre's own), and why.
# Long or heavy barrels, rifles of a pistol calibre, unique and stronger variants higher; snub,
# sawed-off and integrally suppressed guns lower. On top of it: the ammo load, barrel and
# suppressor mods, and the game's projectile-speed multiplier.
# Written without the game's files at hand: the game's log names (at the first shot after the
# main menu) every entry that matched no weapon and every calibre gun without an entry, so the
# editor IDs can be corrected. A gun without an entry gets its damage against its calibre's

column3: La Longue Carabine: unique long barrel
Survivalist's Rifle: rifle barrel for a pistol round
That Gun: pistol barrel for a rifle round
Abilene Kid LE BB gun: unique
